bio: Type designer from Mumbai, based in Berlin, specializing in Devanagari typefaces. Graduate of Communication Design at the National Institute of Fashion Technology, New Delhi, with a Master's in Visual Communication from the Industrial Design Centre, IIT Bombay. Interned at Linotype in Germany, studied on the Typeface Design Intensive course at the University of Reading, then freelanced at several type foundries before joining Mota Italic as a partner alongside Rob Keller in 2014. Designed the Devanagari component of the Fit typeface with David Jonathan Ross in 2021, and the Lini typeface, awarded a Certificate of Excellence by the Type Directors Club (TDC67).
